newsitem.title: USA: ValuJet completes $80 mln debt placement.
newsitem.headline: ValuJet completes $80 mln debt placement.

text.p: ValuJet Airlines Inc said Friday it had completed a private placement with institutional investors of $80 million of 10-1/2 percent senior secured notes due 2001.
ValuJet, which offered the notes on August 7, said in a statement it will use the net proceeds of the offering to refinance certain secured debt and finance the purchase of hushkits.

"The company will no longer be subject to any financial maintenance covenant tests, and approximately $50 million of principal payments that would have been due between now and April 2001 under our previous bank financing has now been deferred," it said.
ValuJet Airlines, a wholly-owned subsidiary of ValuJet Inc, operates 200 peak daily departures to 24 cities.
